summary: Dolores County, CO tower on the San Juan NF, dated to the 1910s and taken down in the 1920s. No source describes what remains at the site today.

facts.status_note: Register says it was taken down in the 1920s; Forest Lookouts and FFA lists also mark it removed

events.note: Register says only 'the 1910s'; 1910 stands in for the decade
Register says only 'the 1920s'; 1920 stands in for the decade

evidence.supports: tower built in the 1910s and taken down in the 1920s
evidence.quote: This tower was built in the 1910s and was taken down in the 1920s.

evidence.supports: on the San Juan National Forest; listed as removed
evidence.quote: BEAVER MOUNTAIN Dolores County San Juan National Forest Removed

evidence.supports: listed as removed, with FFLOS US 532 number

notes_for_editor: Only the FFLOS detail page gives any description (built in the 1910s, taken down in the 1920s); the other two sources say only removed. Brief lat/lon and elevation match FFLOS to rounding. The brief lists kind as unknown, but FFLOS calls it 'This tower'; the FFA list says Unknown type, so the editor may want kind=tower. No staffing, fire, access or remains information found, so those keys are left out. The site's register entry and the San Juan National Forest are the only place-level sources.
